about: A box of one colour, or of two to four, over a checkerboard that shows a translucent colour as translucent. The swatch has no text, so write the colour's name or value beside it where a person needs it.
caption: Cinder's colours

mix.about: Two to four colours in one box: two halves, two quarters over a half, or four quarters. `ColorSwatchMix` selects the division from the number of colours it receives.
mix.title: Mixes

palette.about: A theme's four colours as square swatches in an attached group, so the colours meet without gaps.
palette.title: A palette

sentence.about: `inherit` sizes the swatch to 1em, so it matches the height of the surrounding text and is centred on it.
sentence.title: In a sentence

shape.about: Square corners for a row of colours without gaps, rounded corners by default, and a circle for a picked value.
shape.title: Shapes

size.about: Every step of the icon scale, `full`, which fills its container, and `inherit`, which takes the height of the surrounding text.
size.title: Sizes

themes.about: Each palette theme as a round mix of its four colours next to its name, as a theme picker lists them.
themes.title: Themes

title: Color swatch

tokens.about: A table of colour tokens: the swatch, the role and the value. The value is written out, because the swatch has no text a screen reader can read.
tokens.title: Colour tokens

translucent.about: An opaque red and the same red at 40% opacity. The checkerboard shows through the translucent one.
translucent.title: Translucent
